plan.title: Counter offer on a global field

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with a vendor bid on the buyer side.
Reach the QCS where the vendor bid and Counter Offer action are available.
Send the available counter offer from the vendor's QCS column; the catalog's counter-offer flow handles the send action but not global-field selection.
Assert that the buyer's QCS marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer initiated.
